paragraphs.text: Tarkir 's timeline is not straightforward. It is a twin timeline that branches at one point with one influencing the other. The story of Sarkhan Vol is a straightforward path that winds through both timelines. For clarity, the Khans of Tarkir timeline where the dragons died out is referred to as the "Original timeline", while the Dragons of Tarkir timeline where they dragonlords took over the clans is referred to as the "Current timeline".
Ugin and Nicol Bolas are born on Dominaria
Between c. -20,000 and c. -15,500
Ugin 's rebirth and subsequent planeswalk to Tarkir .
Sparking of the Dragon tempests and birth of the future Dragonlords .
Founding of the Mardu Horde .
Founding of the Abzan Houses .
Founding of the Jeskai Way . Ugin teaches the Jeskai the Ways of Ugin's Fire (Soulfire, Mistfire, Deathfire, Bloodfire, Vitalfire, Ghostfire).
Founding of the Temur Frontier . Ugin teaches the Shamans the Mind Whisper
Founding of the Sultai Brood .
Alesha chooses her war name.
Alesha becomes khan of the Mardu.
Nicol Bolas corrupts Yasova Dragonclaw
Battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas . Bolas coerces the Dragon broods to attack their progenitor.
Ugin dies. The dragon tempests cease.
The Dragons are hunted to extinction:
Silumgar is slain at Molderfang Falls.
Ojutai was slain at the Cori Mountain Fortress.
Kolaghan was slain on the steppes near Scream Reach.
Atarka was slain in the Karakyk Valley.
Dromoka was slain and she and her brood were harvested for their scales.
Narset becomes khan of the Jeskai.
Sarkhan Vol 's Planeswalker's spark ignites and he leaves Tarkir.
Sidisi becomes khan of the Sultai.
Surrak becomes khan of the Temur.
Zurgo becomes khan of the Mardu.
Taigam leaves the Jeskai and joins the Sultai.
Anafenza becomes khan of the Abzan.
Sarkhan returns to Tarkir.
Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and finds Ugin dead.
Varuk takes control of the Mardu after Zurgo's obsession with Sarkhan becomes clear.
The appearance of the Alabaster Kirin .
Sarkhan, Narset, and Zurgo reach Ugin's Nexus.
Sarkhan enters the Nexus of Fate and travels 1280 years backward in time.
Sarkhan encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon. The dragon tempests increase.
c. 3282 or later After the fall of Ugin, the dragon tempests grow in ferocity, giving the dragons the upper hand in the struggle:
The rakshasa and naga forsake the Sultai. Tasigur surrenders to Silumgar .
Daghatar decides to ally with Dromoka and her brood, forcing all of the Abzan to give up ancestor worship. The Remembrance is destroyed, and every kin-tree is uprooted.

Shu Yun , khan of the Jeskai; Alesha , khan of the Mardu; Reyhan , khan of the Abzan holdouts; Yasova, khan of the Temur; and Tasigur hold a meeting at Dirgur stronghold to discuss the future of their clans. Tasigur betrays the location to the dragonlords. Reyhan is killed by Silumgaar. Shu Yun and the other Ghostfire initiates of the Jeskai give up their lives to make peace with Ojutai . Alesha, Yasova, and Tasigur escape.
Tasigur returns to Silumgar and is turned into a piece of jewelry for the dragon.
Alesha and the Mardu decide to forsake their previous clan and follow dragonlord Kolaghan .
Yasova and the Temur begin hunting food for Atarka .
Kolaghan takes full control of the other races that are following her brood.
the Kolaghan clan adopts cannibalism
Anafenza is executed by her cousin Oret and returned by him as a kin-tree spirit .
Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.
Narset's planeswalker spark ignites.
Sarkhan Vol returns to his present, though he was never born in this timeline.
Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his Hedron cocoon.
New Phyrexian Invasion
In the reconstruction from the Phyrexian invasion, rebellions form against the dragonlords, culminating in the Stormnexus Ritual .
Elspeth Tirel travels to Tarkir and recruits Narset to investigate the multiversal dragonstorm outbreak.

Elspeth and Narset's search leads them via Omenpath to the Meditation Realm , where Ugin is detaining Nicol Bolas , and where they find Jace, Loot and Vraska. In this encounter, Elspeth accidentally tells Bolas his name, and Jace steals the Spirit-Gem in an attempt to exploit the Meditation Realm's power to change past, particularly to undo the Phyrexian invasion. He fails and seemingly dies, and Nicol Bolas escapes in the process. After everyone else has departed the Meditation Realm, Jace beings to reform.
Sarkhan Vol and Taigam perform a corrupted ritual and gain control of the plane's wild dragons, which Sarkhan uses to wreak havoc.
Ugin returns to Tarkir, defeats Sarkhan, and puts a stop to the dragonstorm outbreak.
Sarkhan is born as Vol. He later grants himself the title Sarkhan.
Sarkhan rises through the Mardu Horde.
Sarkhan joins Chianul and the Whisperers in the Qal Sisma mountains of the Temur Frontier.
Sarkhan returns to the Mardu.
Sarkhan's planeswalker spark ignites.
Sarkhan returns to Tarkir.
Sarkhan befriends Narset.
Sarkhan finds the tomb of the spirit dragon Ugin .
Sarkhan is sent back in time to the "Crux of Fate."
Sarkhan arrives in Tarkir's past.
Sarkhan cocoons the dying Ugin.
Sarkhan returns to modern-day Tarkir.
Sarkhan meets with Ugin.
Sarkhan meets Narset again.
Sarkhan returns to Tarkir with Narset.
Sarkhan loses his planeswalker spark alongside others, including Narset.
Taigam convinces Sarkhan to perform a corrupted ritual which restores Sarkhan to dragon form, and gives him dominion over the plane's feral dragons.
Ugin returns from the Meditation Realm and defeats Sarkhan.
